submitted.rationale: Best measured EQE was 0.00379% at Sb = 0.499, which is the BiSbO4 stoichiometry and a known photoanode phase. EQE rose with Sb from 0.09 to 0.25 to 0.50, then fell at 0.66 (0.00301%). It also fell at the nearby 0.46 point (0.00248%), which points to a peak close to the BiSbO4 composition.
